name: hs-embed-1
purpose: Multilingual text embedding model built for the Hindsight agent-memory project, small enough for CPU serving (card).

license.name: MIT (card tag)
license.notes: Card front matter says mit; no LICENSE file in the repo (404).

architecture.kind: ModernBERT bi-encoder, 112M parameters of which 98M are the token embedding table (13M-parameter transformer), 384-dim Matryoshka (256/128/64), 8192 tokens, mean pooling, no prompts

pc-12gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-16gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-64gb+.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

weaknesses: benchmark charts are images; no numbers in the card text
soft.maturity: Embedding for one project's memory layer.

tona_fit.reason: A small German-capable embedder, but with no readable benchmarks; bge-m3 and Qwen3-Embedding have far more evidence. Candidate only for CPU-only retrieval where 0.4 GB and speed matter.

open_questions: Benchmark chart images not read; MTEB or MMTEB scores unknown
Why the vendor chose this base is not stated
